title: HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2611.14059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. translated_title: HandsOnAid：构建并评估面向应急响应场景的离线急救助手
translated_abstract: 紧急情况可能发生在没有手机信号且附近没有救护车的地方。在这种情况下，手机上的小型语言模型可能会有所帮助，但其建议必须安全且准确。我们构建了HandsOnAid，这是一个4位量化的Gemma 2B模型，通过QLoRA在FirstAidQA数据集（包含5,550个急救问答对的语料库）上进行了微调。我们比较了七种配置，包括基础模型、4位和8位微调模型，以及带有长度下限、安全门控或检索功能的版本。我们使用了一个包含41对问答的题库，其医学审核参考遵循ANZCOR指南，并采用严格的0-5分评分标准，包含十二项安全否决机制。四个前沿大语言模型评审（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.3）对所有答案进行了盲评，并使用45个隐藏对照组来检验评审的可靠性。微调使平均分数比基础模型提高了1.08，达到2.34。最佳配置得分为5分中的2.51分。
tldr: 本文构建了HandsOnAid——一个可在无信号、无救援环境中通过QLoRA微调的4位Gemma 2B模型实现的离线手机急救助手，并通过四个前沿大模型盲评验证了微调显著提升了急救建议的质量与安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents HandsOnAid, an offline phone-based first-aid assistant for emergency scenarios without signal, built by fine-tuning a 4-bit Gemma 2B model with QLoRA on a 5,550-pair QA dataset, with blind evaluations by four frontier LLM judges confirming that fine-tuning significantly improved the quality and safety of first-aid advice.
